name: Plant Physiology
summary: How plants take in water and nutrients, fix carbon, sense their environment and use hormones to control growth.

topics.name: Water relations: water potential, transpiration and the cohesion-tension theory
Phloem transport: pressure-flow and source-sink relationships
Mineral nutrition, soils and nutrient uptake
Photosynthesis in the leaf: light, CO2 and environmental limits
Plant hormones: auxin, cytokinin, gibberellin, abscisic acid, ethylene, brassinosteroids, jasmonate
Abiotic stress: drought, salt, heat and cold
Plant defences against herbivores and pathogens
